source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 3:13 (the final letters; the elders' transmission)
claim_en: ve-amru LI MA SHEMO MA omar alehem ('and they will say to me: WHAT IS HIS NAME? — what shall I say to them?'): the FINAL LETTERS of the four words li-ma-shemo-ma spell the FOUR-LETTER NAME itself (checked mechanically — yod, he, vav, he: the Name stands hidden in the finals of the very question that asks for it) — 'the Name of four letters that He handed him; and written right after: GO, GATHER THE ELDERS of Israel — for it is transmitted only to the elders of the generation' (the Kitzur): the question carries its own answer in the letters, and the letter files the transmission-protocol beside it.

source: the stream's own census on Exod 3:16 (gen_73's password file; the Kitzur's count named)
claim_en: PAQOD PAQADTI etkhem ('I have surely VISITED you'): the PAST-TENSE twin of the bones-oath's formula — and the stream's census now holds the COMPLETE four-station file of the doubled visit-word: SPOKEN in the future tense (paqod yifqod, Gen 50:24), SWORN into the bones-oath (Gen 50:25), handed to Moses in the PAST tense here as the elders' password (3:16 — the only past-tense station), and REDEEMED at the bones-carrying (Exod 13:19, armed): gen_73's file [G73-02] closed from the Exodus end — the sign the readings say was transmitted down the generations arrives in the mouth it was waiting for (adjacency checked; the Kitzur's letter-count named).

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 3:5 (the Ramah's book-rule; the Masorah on the footstool)
claim_en: The holy ground's TWO unique-full words, one verse: RAGLEKHA ('your FEET') — the Ramah's rule ('full yod in the first four books of the Torah; all of Deuteronomy lean') verified WHOLE and sharper than stated: the full your-feet stands exactly ONCE in the Torah — at 'remove your sandals from your feet' on the holy ground — and Deuteronomy's three tokens are all lean (census checked; the Masorah's one full exception in the Writings, the Psalms footstool, named); and OMED ('STANDING') — 'this alone written full vav in the Torah' (MS): the stand-word full exactly once, in 'the place on which you are STANDING' (checked): the verse that consecrates ground fills both the feet and the standing.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 3:13 (the unique full-of-full)
claim_en: elohe AVOTEKHEM ('the God of your FATHERS'): 'this alone FULL-OF-FULL in the Torah — full vav and full yod' (MS) — and the census verifies the ruling whole: the fathers-word with both letters stands exactly ONCE in the Torah, in Moses' rehearsal of the sending ('I will say to them: the God of your FATHERS sent me'), while the lean form stands eight times — including TWICE in this very passage (3:15 and 3:16, the same phrase in God's own reply): the delivery-verse is one letter fuller than the reply it rehearses (checked — the run's fullest echo of the full-of-full 'our fathers' at Gen 47:3, gen_70's marquee).

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 3:4 (Shemot Rabbah; the Zohar; a manuscript Masorah)
claim_en: MOSHE MOSHE ('Moses, Moses'): the Masorah's FOUR doubled names — Abraham Abraham (the knife-verse), Jacob Jacob (the night-visions), Samuel Samuel — 'and ALL of them have the PAUSE-LINE between, except MOSES MOSES, which has none: for from the day he was born the Presence never withdrew from him; with every other prophet He paused — with Moses He never paused all his days' (Shemot Rabbah via MS; the Zohar's first-not-equal-to-last reading of the paused pairs named); the manuscript Masorah MS quotes adds the datum the stream CAN carry: 'and Moses is with TIFCHA — because he heard from the speaking-mouth in the shining glass' — checked against the stream's own mark (the second Moses bears the tifcha exactly); the pause-line itself lives below the token-layer (instrument gap, named): the unbroken call, carried with its one checkable mark verified.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 3:2 (his correction of the printed Shorashim; the Mikhlol; the Ramah; Minchat Kohen)
claim_en: ve-ha-sene enenu UKAL ('and the bush was not CONSUMED'): written LEAN — no vav, the kaf DAGESHED, the alef on its three dots (checked in-stream) — with the Masorah ('unique and lean'), the Mikhlol in both folios, Minchat Kohen, and the Ramah all concurring; and MS solves a corruption in the PRINTED Shorashim (which reads 'full'): a copyist attached the word 'full' from the preceding Nahum quotation to the bush-verse — 'and I have proof from the Baal HaLashon, who copies Radak's words' — the chain CORRECTING ITS OWN TRANSMISSION at the very word that burns without being consumed: the un-consumed word, un-corrupted by collation.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 3:15 (Pesachim/Kiddushin; Shemot Rabbah; the Temple practice)
claim_en: ze shemi LE-OLAM ('this is My name FOREVER'): written LEAN — and the lean skeleton IS the law: 'le-ALEM it is written' (TO CONCEAL — the old man to Rava, who had meant to expound the Name publicly; Pesachim and Kiddushin); 'not as I am written am I read: written yod-he, read alef-dalet' (R. Avina's pairing of MY-NAME with MY-MEMORIAL in this verse); the Temple said the Name as written, the province by its epithet; the high priest's ten utterances and the falling ranks named (the Jerusalem Talmud's 'until it vanished from them — ze shemi le-olam, ze shemi le-alem'): the stream carries the lean token exactly (checked, with the dageshed shin of zeh SHEMI asserted beside it): the verse that installs the Name forever spells forever thin — and the chain reads the missing vav as the veil.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 3:20 (the Ramah against two Masorot)
claim_en: ve-HIKETI et mitzrayim ('and I will STRIKE Egypt'): FULL yod before the tav 'in all precise copies of the whole Torah' with the Masorah 'all of them full' — and MS reports TWO rival Masorot (one counting four full; one splitting the Torah's pair one-lean-one-full) and rules them BOTH corruptions (shibusha) with the Ramah, 'for all the precise copies dispute them': the census verifies the Ramah's side whole — the strike-word stands exactly THREE times in the Torah, ALL full, the lean census EMPTY: the wonders-strike here (3:20), the firstborn-strike ('and I will strike every firstborn,' 12:12), and the sevenfold-strike of the covenant-curses (Lev 26:24) — the three first-person strikes of God, none thinned (checked).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 3:7 (the Masorah's pair)
claim_en: ve-et TZAAKATAM shamati ('and their CRY I have heard'): the their-cry word stands exactly TWICE in the Torah — SODOM'S ('their cry has grown great before the LORD,' Gen 19:13, the destroying angels' warrant) and ISRAEL'S here — 'to tell you their cry was as great as the cry of Sodom' (the Kitzur): the letter files the oppression of Egypt in the same word-form as the city God overthrew (census checked): the pair the readings draw is the pair the stream carries — and the doubled seeing of the verse (rao RAITI, 'I have surely SEEN') opens the five-afflictions count the bush-census answers [EX03-10].

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 3:7 (the five bush-words)
claim_en: ha-SENE ('the BUSH'): the Kitzur counts — the doubled seeing of 3:7 stands against FIVE oppressions (the crushing service, the embittering, the pressure, the affliction, the hard service), 'and against them the BUSH stands FIVE times in the passage' — and the stream verifies the count exact: the bush-word appears five times in the Torah and ALL FIVE in this section — ha-sene four tokens (3:2 twice, 3:3, 3:4) and ve-ha-sene one (3:2) — nowhere else in the five books does the burning bush's noun appear (census checked; Deut 33:16's 'Dweller of the bush' carries a different skeleton, named): five oppressions, five bushes, one thornbush that learns fire without being eaten — 'for I am with him in distress' (the Kitzur's sign at 3:6's hidden face).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 3:19 (the Masorah's Torah-pair; the three counselors)
claim_en: LA-HALOKH ('to GO'): the walk-infinitive of refused leave stands exactly TWICE in the Torah — PHARAOH'S refusal foreseen here ('the king of Egypt will not GIVE you to go') and BALAAM'S at the Moab embassy ('the LORD REFUSED to give me to go with you,' Num 22:13) — and the Kitzur binds them with the three-counselors tradition: 'three sat in that counsel — Jethro, Job, and Balaam' (Jethro of THIS chapter's opening verse; the readings' Job-in-Moses'-days hint filed at the reed-census, exo_02): the give-to-go word pairs the king who would not let Israel walk with the prophet not given to walk against them (census checked).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 3:16/18/21/22 (the going-out pairs)
claim_en: The going-out files, four Masorah-pairs at the commission: TELEKHUN ('you shall go') — exactly twice in the Torah (checked): 'you shall not go EMPTY' here and 'you shall not go AFTER OTHER GODS' (Deut 6:14) — the Kitzur's discard-the-idols charge landing on the Torah-side pair itself (Ezekiel's throw-away-the-detestable named); u-SEMALOT ('and garments') — twice (3:22 the promise, 12:35 the performance — the two-garments reading named: one to bind the dough, one to wear, 'and your garment did not wear out'); he-ASUY ('that which is DONE/wrought') — twice (the done-to-you of Egypt 3:16, the gold WROUGHT for the work 38:24: 'all the gold that came up with them from Egypt was set apart for the Tabernacle's work'); ve-SHAMU ('and they will hear') — the mission-pair named (your-voice heard 3:18; 'Egypt will hear' Num 14:13) with the stream's full census printed: the testament's doubled hearken (Gen 49:2 twice) shares the skeleton (asserted): the promise-verses of chapter three each carry a receipt-verse in the letter's own pairs.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 3:11/14/15/19/20; Minchat Shai on 3:10/12/21/22 (named-only files)
claim_en: The commission's named-only files, with one count-check: EHYEH ('I WILL BE') stands exactly THREE times in the revelation-verse (checked in-verse) — 'against the three fathers' (the Kitzur; the gematria networks — twenty-one, the forty-two-letter Name from the doubling, the sixty-three of the tribes' letters — named as instrument-gap arithmetic); MI ANOKHI ('who am I,' 3:11) — its one Torah station (asserted), David's 'who am I... that You have brought me HALOM' named: 'halom is nothing but KINGSHIP — Moses asked kingship and was refused: al tiqrav HALOM' (the Kitzur binding 3:5's own approach-ban into the refusal); LEKHA with the certainty-HE (3:10 — 'if you do not redeem them, no other redeems them,' Vayikra Rabbah via MS; the station asserted); the BENT NUN of va-ani yadati (3:19 — fifty plagues hinted; letter-shape beyond the stream); ASHER in gematria = the plague-acronym (3:20 — 'the plagues were inscribed in its midst'; named); va-YASTER ('and he hid,' 3:6) — Torah-unique (asserted), Job's hidden-toil pair named ('had he gazed and begged mercy, the exile would have shortened'); and MS's accent-file (the ki of 3:12 on meteg-and-hyphen with the alef bare; the favor-word on the lengthening-stroke not the drop; the this-people hyphenated in manuscripts; the dotted gimel of the sojourner-word 3:22) — all carried named.
